DatasetToBuild.description:
A build request, as the Datasets form sends it. Days are real dates (UTC); limits are
shares (0.03 is 3%).
DatasetToBuild.title: DatasetToBuild

DayMark.description: Something the page marks beside the table, at the step it happened.
DayMark.title: DayMark

DecisionLine.description: One asset looked at, at one step, and what came of it.
DecisionLine.title: DecisionLine

Fallback.description: The broader group the agent reads in place of a line under the minimum sample.
Fallback.title: Fallback

FilterCounts.description: How many lines each filter would keep, so each filter can say so.
FilterCounts.title: FilterCounts

Group.description: The finished sims of one side: their ending account values, average and spread.

Meters.description: The three thin meters, the spending one aside (its figures are the key figures).
Meters.title: Meters

OrderLine.description: One order: what the agent (or code) decided, and whether it was carried out.
OrderLine.title: OrderLine

PerformanceWinner.description: Which model's sims with memory ended higher, by the verdict's own test.
PerformanceWinner.title: PerformanceWinner

Price.description: A price as it really was, and as the agent saw it (rescaled).

PriceWinner.description:
Which model cost fewer real dollars per full evaluation or position review, dollar
for dollar, no margin.
PriceWinner.title: PriceWinner

QualityCheck.description: The build's first step: each asset's numbers against the two limits, and the verdict.
QualityCheck.title: QualityCheck

Refusals.description: Why a request to start, stop or resume was refused: every reason at once.
Refusals.title: Refusals

SimCheck.description:
May this sim start, and what would it cost? Every refusal at once, and the money in US
dollars: the estimate and cap of all the sims the request creates, and what is left under
the ceiling for new sims (money paid and other sims' caps taken off).

SimToStart.description:
A sim to start. Days are real dates (UTC); give a test period or days, or neither for
every day after the warm-up.

SpendingTotal.description: Real dollars paid to Jev and the LLM so far, and the most the project may pay.

Split.description: A detail that narrows a group, in the order the ladder adds them.

TradeLine.description: A trade, or a full evaluation that ended in no trade (`kind` "no trade").
TradeLine.title: TradeLine

TradeTick.description: One trade: a tick on the chart where it opened.

May this sim start, and what would it cost? Takes what starting a sim takes; stores
nothing and starts nothing. The New trading sim form asks it as its choices change.

The quick figures, asked for every second while the sim is in progress.

The account, its positions, and the trades around one moment.

get.description:
The trades table, a page at a time, oldest first.

Each of `lost_money`, `trimmed` (by a risk limit), `stop_price` (closed at it) and
`overnight` (held past midnight UTC) keeps only the trades it names; `no_trade` adds the
full evaluations that ended in no trade.
